items.title: Allen Toussaint Interview, 1979-03-13
items.q: I played the piano for Dave, and I may have assisted some, but Dave was actually the producer there.

ctx.x: And so forth. How did you get involved in production work? Was that through Dave Bartholomew?

Well, I guess he may have been one of my early introducers to that field, but I didn't actually produce for Dave. I played the piano for Dave, and I may have assisted some, but Dave was actually the producer there. I actually got into production, I guess, with minute records first. I had been doing what was equivalent to that a few times before with others that came into the studio sometime. Someone would bring an artist through without material or anything and send him in and tell him to go to the piano player…
That was with Larry McKinley and Dave Bartholomew originally?
